name: iwac-mcp-server
description: Read-only access to the Islam West Africa Collection via Hugging Face datasets.
long_description:
Search and analyse the Islam West Africa Collection (IWAC): ~12,000 newspaper articles, 1,500 Islamic publications (searchable by keyword, subject, series, and table of contents), 4,700 index entries, plus audiovisual recordings, fieldwork photographs, archival documents, and academic references. Includes AI sentiment analysis (Gemini polarity/centrality), per-article AI abstracts, and per-year coverage timelines. All matching is accent- and case-insensitive.

**No API key is required for the 27 core tools** (cross-subset search/fetch, keyword search, filtering, statistics, timelines, item details). Three optional semantic-search tools use Gemini embeddings — over all articles, the publication series with tables of contents, and the photographs (cross-modal: describe what an image shows) — and need a free Google/Gemini API key; these are disabled by default.

On first use the server downloads ~250 MB of parquet data from Hugging Face into a local cache.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Cross-subset search across IWAC articles, publications, documents, references, index records, audiovisual materials, and photographs. Two-phase: curated metadata first, full OCR only when needed. Returns namespaced ids for fetch.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one IWAC item by a namespaced id returned from search, including canonical URL, text, category, and metadata.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Search newspaper articles by French keyword (title, OCR, AI abstract), country, newspaper, subject, and date range.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Get full metadata, AI abstract, sentiment, and OCR text for a specific article.

tools.name: semantic_search_articles
tools.description: Optional. Semantic similarity search over article OCR. Disabled by default — requires a free Google/Gemini API key.

tools.name: search_by_sentiment
tools.description: Filter articles by Gemini polarity and centrality labels.

tools.name: get_sentiment_distribution
tools.description: Aggregate Gemini sentiment stats across a filter set. Renders as interactive donut charts in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: search_index
tools.description: Search the authority index (persons, places, organisations, events, subjects).

tools.name: get_index_entry
tools.description: Get full details of an index entry.

tools.name: list_subjects
tools.description: List subject terms ranked by frequency.

tools.name: list_locations
tools.description: List locations from the index, ranked by frequency. The optional country filter selects places mentioned in that country's records (not places located there).

tools.name: list_persons
tools.description: List persons from the index, ranked by frequency. The optional country filter selects persons mentioned in that country's records.

tools.name: get_collection_stats
tools.description: Overall stats for all seven IWAC subsets, including how much of each carries searchable full text (fulltext_coverage). Renders as an interactive treemap with full-text coverage gauges in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_newspaper_stats
tools.description: Per-newspaper article counts and date ranges. Renders as an interactive ranked bar chart in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_country_comparison
tools.description: Compare article counts and sentiment across countries. Renders as interactive comparison charts in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_temporal_distribution
tools.description: Coverage over time: counts of matching items per year or month, with the standard filters and optional grouping by country or newspaper. Renders as an interactive chart in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_topic_distribution
tools.description: How a filtered set of articles distributes across the 30 precomputed LDA topics, optionally over time. Renders as an interactive treemap and stacked timeline in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_field_distribution
tools.description: Rank the values of one multi-valued field (subject, spatial, author, language, newspaper, country) across a filtered set, optionally with the per-year share of items carrying a value. Renders as an interactive ranking in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_cooccurrence
tools.description: How often the top values of a multi-valued field appear on the same item — a subject or place co-mention matrix. Renders as an interactive heatmap in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_lexical_metrics
tools.description: Readability, lexical richness (MATTR) and length of the press text by year, newspaper or country. Renders as interactive charts in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: search_publications
tools.description: Search Islamic publications (periodical issues, books) by French keyword (title, subject, table of contents, OCR), series, subject, country, and year.

tools.name: list_periodicals
tools.description: List the periodical/series titles in the publications subset, with issue counts and year ranges. Renders as an interactive runs gantt in hosts that support MCP Apps.

tools.name: get_publication_fulltext
tools.description: Retrieve full OCR text of a publication, optionally with capped keyword excerpts.

tools.name: semantic_search_publications
tools.description: Optional. Semantic similarity search over publication tables of contents (17 of 25 series covered). Disabled by default — requires a free Google/Gemini API key.

tools.name: search_references
tools.description: Search multilingual academic references (journal articles, chapters, theses, books, reports) by title/abstract keyword, author, French metadata labels, country, language, and year; returns an abstract snippet.

tools.name: get_reference
tools.description: Get the full bibliographic record for a reference, including the complete abstract, DOI, subjects, and host-work details.

tools.name: search_documents
tools.description: Search the archival-documents subset with French keywords (association reports, flyers — mostly Burkina Faso).

tools.name: get_document
tools.description: Get full metadata, AI description, and OCR text for an archival document.

tools.name: search_audiovisual
tools.description: Search audiovisual materials by keyword, transcription, and metadata (Nigeria; includes Hausa and Arabic recordings).

tools.name: get_audiovisual
tools.description: Get full metadata, media URL, and transcription (where one exists) for a specific audiovisual record.

tools.name: list_audiovisual
tools.description: List audiovisual materials (Nigeria; includes Hausa and Arabic recordings).

tools.name: search_images
tools.description: Search the fieldwork photographs by keyword, country, subject, place, photographer, and date. Returns image URLs and coordinates.

tools.name: get_image
tools.description: Get full metadata, coordinates, IIIF manifest, and full-resolution image URL for a specific photograph.

tools.name: semantic_search_images
tools.description: Optional. Cross-modal search: find photographs by describing what they show, ranked against a multimodal embedding of the image itself. Disabled by default — requires a free Google/Gemini API key.

cache_dir.title: Dataset cache directory
cache_dir.description: Where to store the downloaded IWAC parquet files (~250 MB on first run). Leave default to use your home directory.

semantic_search_enabled.title: Enable semantic search (optional)
semantic_search_enabled.description: Most users can leave this off. Enables three extra tools that find articles, publications and photographs by meaning rather than keywords. Requires a free Google/Gemini API key and uses network calls at query time. The other 27 tools work without this.

google_api_key.title: Google / Gemini API key
google_api_key.description: Required only if semantic search is enabled. Get a free key at https://aistudio.google.com/apikey.

embedding_model.title: Gemini embedding model
embedding_model.description: Model used to encode semantic-search queries. Must match the embeddings stored in the dataset.
